checkedOccurrences.textualBasisJa: Now these are the kings of the land, whom the children of Israel struck, and possessed their land beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah eastward:

Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the middle of the valley, and half Gilead, even to the river Jabbok, the border of the children of Ammon;
from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain of Medeba to Dibon;
Their border was from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain by Medeba;

wikipediaActualRead.title: Wadi Mujib
wikipediaActualRead.identityBasisJa: 冒頭でWadi Mujibをヨルダンの川、別名Arnon streamとし、記事中に聖書上の境界水域記述がある。記事同定は水系レベル。

geographyAssessmentJa: 川谷・水系の代表候補点としてのみ地図表示可。河口や河川境界の精密線を示すものではない。

sourceLinkCorrections.reasonJa: プロフィールと実読証拠が採用するWadi Mujib記事にsource entryを一致させる。旧Arnon article linkは履歴へ保持。
